opening.argument: The video presents an enterprise software discussion focused on Apprenda's Java capabilities and reported production use, rather than an invitation to financial participation. The speaker states that the platform has “best-in-class support for Java” and that functionality from the .NET side has been brought over, describing product capabilities in an interview-style setting. The presentation also identifies JPMorgan Chase as a production customer and reports “over 2,000 applications across 500 development teams.” Visible Apprenda branding and the Java and JPMorgan Chase title are consistent with an ordinary product discussion, with no supplied evidence of payment, reward, or financial participation.

citations.quote: The Apprenda platform now has best-in-class support for Java.
Coming to market with production customers like JPMorgan Chase is simply amazing.
With over 2,000 applications across 500 development teams
